Subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive — proposed agenda & times

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and super helpful context on where Acme is focusing first. Quick recap from our discovery call:

- Primary goal: integrate Redwood inference to reduce latency for clinical note summarization and power a real-time triage assistant.
- Data shape: semi-structured EHR notes (~1-2k tokens per request on average), PII redaction required, retention policy = 7 years.
- Key constraints: security/compliance (audit logs, KMS), low p95 latency, and predictable cost for bursty traffic.

Next step: we'd like to schedule a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra leads so our solutions + SRE team can walk through architecture, data flows, security controls, and a short demo of a production-like evaluation. Proposed agenda (draft):

1) 10 min — introductions & objectives
2) 20-30 min — architecture and data flow review (ingest, tokenization, storage, redaction)
3) 20 min — model serving options, latency/throughput tradeoffs, quantization and batching strategies
4) 10-15 min — security, KMS, audit logs, and compliance checklist
5) 10-15 min — demo + next steps / action items

Proposed times (ET) next week — please confirm which work for you / your team or share alternatives:
- Tue 2027-03-09: 11:00-12:30 ET
- Wed 2027-03-10: 14:00-15:30 ET
- Thu 2027-03-11: 10:00-11:30 ET

Please confirm attendees (esp. your ML lead and infra/SRE lead) and any additional topics to add to the agenda. I’ll loop in our SEs once we confirm time.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
